description: This file defines the EventMonitor class, which tracks input event states within an Android input method service. It manages states such as input start, finish, and selection updates, and can output debug messages related to these events.

classes.name: EventMonitor
classes.description: Handles tracking of input session states and interactions for debugging purposes within an Android input method service.

classes.name: EventMonitor.DebugMessageCallback
classes.description: A functional interface for receiving debug message updates from EventMonitor.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Called when input is started or restarted; updates internal state and clones EditorInfo.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Called when input is finished; resets the EditorInfo and updates state.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Called when the selection or composition range updates; updates internal counters and variables.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Compiles current state information into a debug message and invokes callback if available.

methods.name: cloneEditorInfo
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an EditorInfo object via parceling.
